text_en: In the thirty-sixth year of the reign of Asa, King Baasha of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, to prevent anyone from going out or coming into the territory of King Asa of Judah.
text_cn: 阿撒当国第三十六年，以色列王巴厄沙来进攻犹大，在辣玛修筑工事，防止人同犹大王阿撒来往。

text_en: Then Asa took silver and gold from the treasures of the house of the Lord and the king’s house, and sent them to King Ben-hadad of Aram, who resided in Damascus, saying,
text_cn: 当时阿撒拿出上主殿内和王宫府库中的金银，送给住在大马士革的阿兰王本哈达得说：

text_en: “Let there be an alliance between me and you, like that between my father and your father; I am sending to you silver and gold; go, break your alliance with King Baasha of Israel, so that he may withdraw from me. ”
text_cn: “我与你之间，以及我父与你父之间都立过约；现在我给你送来金银作为礼品，请你废除你与以色列王巴厄沙所立的约，使他离开我的国境。”

text_en: Ben-hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the commanders of his armies against the cities of Israel. They conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim, and all the store-cities of Naphtali.
text_cn: 本哈达得听从了阿撒王的话，即刻派军长，去攻打以色列的城市，攻下了依雍、丹、阿贝耳玛因和纳斐塔里所有的屯货城。

text_en: When Baasha heard of it, he stopped building Ramah, and let his work cease.
text_cn: 巴厄沙一听说这事，立即停止在辣玛的工事。

text_en: Then King Asa brought all Judah, and they carried away the stones of Ramah and its timber, with which Baasha had been building, and with them he built up Geba and Mizpah.
text_cn: 阿撒王遂征调全犹大人，将巴厄沙修筑辣玛所用的石头和木材运走，用来修筑革巴和米兹帕。

text_en: At that time the seer Hanani came to King Asa of Judah, and said to him, “Because you relied on the king of Aram, and did not rely on the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has escaped you.
text_cn: 那时，先见者哈纳尼来见犹大王阿撒，对他说：“因为你依靠了阿兰，而没有依靠上主你的天主，因此阿兰王的军队脱离了你。

text_en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge army with exceedingly many chariots and cavalry? Yet because you relied on the Lord , he gave them into your hand.
text_cn: 雇士人和利比亚人不是一支很强大的军队吗？战车骑兵不是很多吗？但几时你依靠上主，他便将他们交在你的手中。

text_en: For the eyes of the Lord range throughout the entire earth, to strengthen those whose heart is true to him. You have done foolishly in this; for from now on you will have wars. ”
text_cn: 上主的眼遍察各地，对所有专心忠于他的，他必大显威能，加以扶助。你这事作得太无知了，今后你必要遭遇战祸。”

text_en: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the stocks, in prison, for he was in a rage with him because of this. And Asa inflicted cruelties on some of the people at the same time.
text_cn: 阿撒对先见者发怒，将他囚在狱中；王在这事上实在生了大气，同时阿撒又虐待了一些百姓。

text_en: The acts of Asa, from first to last, are written in the Book of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
text_cn: 阿撒的前后事迹，都记载在《犹大和以色列列王实录》上。

text_en: In the thirty-ninth year of his reign Asa was diseased in his feet, and his disease became severe; yet even in his disease he did not seek the Lord , but sought help from physicians.
text_cn: 阿撒当国第三十九年，患了足疾，病得十分严重；他在病中不求上主，而只求医。

text_en: Then Asa slept with his ancestors, dying in the forty-first year of his reign.
text_cn: 阿撒在位四十一年逝世，与祖先同眠。

text_en: They buried him in the tomb that he had hewn out for himself in the city of David. They laid him on a bier that had been filled with various kinds of spices prepared by the perfumer’s art; and they made a very great fire in his honor.
text_cn: 人们将他葬在达味城，自己所凿的坟墓里，将他放在床上面，满堆香料，即照调香法所制的各种香料，又为他焚烧了很多的香料。
